name: sourceHasDeathtouch
rules: CR 702.2b any nonzero damage from a deathtouch source is lethal
CR 613.1f deathtouch can be granted in layer 6
contract: Reads the LAYERED view of the damage source, not the printed card. A deathtouch granted by an anthem or an aura counts, and a printed-only read would miss it and let a creature survive that should have died.
Returns false when the source is not on the battlefield or has no view.
Comparison is case-insensitive on the keyword string, because the compiler emits mixed case and layers.ts stores lower case.
Returns a boolean and nothing else. It does not decide lethality; CR 704.5h does, in sba.ts, and a second copy of that decision here would drift.

evidence.claim: deathtouch is a static ability on the source

assertions.given: a vanilla source with deathtouch granted through the layered view
a source that has left the battlefield
